bibliographic.title: In cerca di Tesla
bibliographic.author: High school "Guglielmo Marconi" of Imperia
bibliographic.description:
Italian game written in Inform 6 by the students of the high school "Guglielmo Marconi" of Imperia enrolled in the videogame design course taught by Marco Vallarino.

You play the role of a student of the school. After finding a strange vehicle in the basement of the edifice, you discover it is a time machine. So you start travelling through the time until you find yourself at Central Park in Manhattan, New York City, in the end of the 19th century, when the famous inventor Nikola Tesla did his great shows about electricity in Broadway. He's the only one who could help to come back to your time, so you have to find and convince him to do that.
